lines.text: Did you know? Volv is Latin for roll.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus roll?

words.ex: The language has evolved over centuries.
The job involves a lot of travel.
The internet caused a revolution in communication.

publish.title: Volv root: evolve, involve and revolution
publish.value: Volv comes from Latin "volvere" (to roll, to turn). Words: evolve, involve and revolution. evolve = e + volve; involve = in + volve; revolution = re + volut.
